sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Her body clock still wakes her before sunrise.

brief.meaningEn: The body’s natural daily timing, including when a person tends to feel sleepy or awake.
brief.meaningZh: 身體自然的每日節奏，包括傾向何時想睡或清醒。
brief.grammar: my/her body clock; body clocks in plural; a conventional countable compound noun, not an alarm device.
brief.register: Established everyday biological term. This lesson teaches ordinary reference to daily timing, not diagnosis or treatment.
brief.boundaryZh: 不等於實際鬧鐘、意志力或每人相同作息，也不能從一句話診斷睡眠問題。
brief.misconceptionZh: 分清自然時間感與外在日程；具體原因及調整速度需要更多資訊。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述日常作息節奏而不作未證實健康推論。

options.en: A familiar waking pattern without an alarm being set.
options.zh: 沒有設鬧鐘，仍有熟悉的醒來時間模式。

options.en: An alarm that was deliberately set for the usual workday time.
options.zh: 刻意設在平日上班時間的鬧鐘。

options.en: A holiday plan requiring everyone to get up at the same hour.
options.zh: 要求每人同一小時起床的假期計劃。

options.en: The holiday schedule itself requires the speaker to attend a meeting at that hour.
options.zh: 假期時間表本身要求說話者在那時開會。

listening.explanationZh: 沒有設鬧鐘卻在熟悉時間醒，指自然日常節奏；沒有說假期有會議或每人必須相同作息。
listening.en: Even on holiday, my body clock seems to wake me at my usual workday time, although I have not set an alarm.
listening.zh: 即使放假，我的生理時鐘似乎仍在平日上班時間叫醒我，雖然我沒有設鬧鐘。

reply.promptEn: Why are you awake at your usual workday time even on holiday, without an alarm?
reply.promptZh: 放假沒設鬧鐘，你為甚麼仍在平日上班時間醒？

options.en: I seem to have kept my usual waking pattern.
options.zh: 我似乎保留了平日醒來模式。

options.en: My body clock still seems to follow my workday routine.
options.zh: 我的生理時鐘似乎仍依平日上班節奏。

options.en: My usual routine may help explain why I wake at this hour.
options.zh: 平常作息可能有助解釋我為何這時醒。

options.en: I tend to wake at the familiar time even when I have no appointment.
options.zh: 即使沒有約見，我也傾向在熟悉時間醒。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以已知日常節奏合理回應，保留似乎、可能，不指定未證實病因。

scene.promptZh: 故事人物長期夜間工作，休假第一天仍在平常睡覺時間感到睏；敘事者只描述熟悉節奏，不作診斷。哪句合適？

options.en: Her body clock still seemed to follow her familiar routine.
options.zh: 她的生理時鐘似乎仍依熟悉作息。

options.en: Her employer had explicitly required her to sleep at that time during the holiday.
options.zh: 僱主明確要求她放假時在該時間睡。

options.en: Feeling sleepy at that hour proves that every person should follow her schedule.
options.zh: 那時想睡，證明每人都應跟她的時間表。

scene.explanationZh: 情境只支持個人熟悉節奏，不支持僱主命令或人人同一安排。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項混淆了 body clock 與外在時間要求？

options.en: A reference to natural daily timing.
options.zh: 提及自然每日節奏。

options.en: A meeting was booked for seven, so that booking alone proves the person naturally feels awake then.
options.zh: 會議訂了七時，所以單憑預訂便證明那人自然在那時清醒。

options.en: Different people may describe different familiar waking times.
options.zh: 不同人可能描述不同熟悉醒來時間。

contrast.explanationZh: 外在預訂時間不等於個人自然清醒節奏，需要分開日程與身體時間感。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友以為沒有設鬧鐘，就不可能在熟悉時間自行醒來；你想解釋 body clock。哪句較準確？

options.en: My body clock seems to follow my usual routine even without an alarm being set.
options.zh: 即使沒設鬧鐘，我的生理時鐘似乎仍依平常節奏。

options.en: Assume a hidden alarm must have caused the waking, without asking about the usual routine.
options.zh: 不問平常作息，就假定一定是隱藏鬧鐘叫醒。

options.en: Use the booked holiday activity as proof of the person’s natural waking time.
options.zh: 把預訂假期活動，當作個人自然醒來時間的證據。

dialogue.explanationZh: body clock 指自然每日節奏，與外在鬧鐘及預訂日程不同；seems 保留個人觀察。

speaking.en: My body clock seems to follow my usual routine, even when the day’s schedule is different.
speaking.zh: 即使當天時間表不同，我的生理時鐘似乎仍依平常節奏。
speaking.promptZh: 你想描述個人觀察，保留似乎的語氣。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫虛構旅行日記，人物剛到另一時區，當地晚上還不想睡，猜想自己仍沿原居地作息。用一至兩句英文描寫，保留猜測語氣。

examples.en: In the diary, the traveller thinks her body clock may still be following the time at home. She does not yet feel sleepy at the local bedtime.
examples.zh: 日記中，旅人想自己的生理時鐘可能仍跟着原居地時間。她在當地就寢時間仍不想睡。

examples.en: Her body clock may still be set to her routine at home, as she feels awake at the local bedtime.
examples.zh: 她的生理時鐘可能仍依原居地作息，因為在當地就寢時間她仍清醒。

writing.selfCheckZh: 分開個人自然時間感與新時區日程，用當地就寢時間仍清醒作線索，保留 may、seems 的猜測，而非斷言原因。

takeaways.en: My body clock still seems to follow my old routine.
takeaways.zh: 我的生理時鐘似乎仍依舊作息。

takeaways.en: Our body clocks do not necessarily match the same timetable.
takeaways.zh: 我們的生理時鐘不一定配合同一時間表。

lessons.titleZh: 喜歡深夜活動的夜貓子

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The design team includes several night owls.

brief.meaningEn: People who tend to prefer being awake and active late at night.
brief.meaningZh: 傾向喜歡深夜仍清醒、活躍的人。
brief.grammar: a night owl; several night owls; be a night owl describes a tendency, not necessarily one late night.
brief.register: Informal conventional animal metaphor used as a countable noun for a person.
brief.boundaryZh: 不表示懶惰、失業或必定通宵；偶爾因截止時間熬夜，也不足以證明長期偏好。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要區分通常喜歡的時段與一次外在要求，也不替別人決定應跟誰的作息。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述晚間偏好，並協調共享時間。

options.en: People with a preference for being active late at night.
options.zh: 偏好深夜活動的人。

options.en: People who must have no daytime responsibilities.
options.zh: 必定沒有日間責任的人。

options.en: People who stayed late once despite usually preferring an early bedtime.
options.zh: 平常愛早睡，只偶爾留晚一次的人。

options.en: People who have already agreed to attend meetings only after midnight.
options.zh: 已同意只在午夜後開會的人。

listening.explanationZh: prefer 交代偏好；下午會議反而說明不必每人同一時段或午夜開會。
listening.en: Several designers are night owls who prefer developing ideas late in the evening, so the team agreed a shared afternoon meeting rather than expecting everyone to keep the same hours.
listening.zh: 幾位設計師是夜貓子，較喜歡深夜構思想法，所以團隊議定下午共同會議，而非要求每人作息相同。

reply.promptEn: Why did the designers choose a shared afternoon meeting rather than identical working hours?
reply.promptZh: 設計師為甚麼選下午共同會議，而非完全相同工作時段？

options.en: Their preferred times for developing ideas were not all the same.
options.zh: 他們偏好構思的時段不盡相同。

options.en: Some of them are night owls.
options.zh: 有些人是夜貓子。

options.en: The group wanted a time that could work across different routines.
options.zh: 小組想找能配合不同作息的時段。

options.en: A common meeting could support collaboration without dictating every individual work period.
options.zh: 共同會議可支援合作，不必規定每人的每段工作時間。

reply.explanationZh: 四句皆解釋協調不同作息，不把偏好當不負責任或沒有共同安排。

scene.promptZh: 朋友通常喜歡晚上構思，也樂於安排翌日共同交接；你只想描述她的時段偏好。哪句貼切？

options.en: She is a night owl who likes developing ideas late in the evening.
options.zh: 她是夜貓子，喜歡深夜構思。

options.en: She stayed up once for an emergency but normally dislikes late evenings.
options.zh: 她因急事熬夜一次，平常不喜歡夜間。

options.en: Her preference proves she cannot keep any daytime commitment.
options.zh: 她的偏好證明她無法履行任何日間承諾。

scene.explanationZh: 通常喜歡夜間才支持偏好稱呼；一次例外與責任能力推論不同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以把某人稱為 night owl？

options.en: A stated tendency to enjoy quiet creative work late at night.
options.zh: 表示傾向喜歡深夜安靜創作。

options.en: One unusually late evening caused by an urgent task, despite a usual early bedtime.
options.zh: 通常早睡，只因急事罕有留晚一晚。

options.en: A regular preference for later evening activity rather than early morning activity.
options.zh: 平常偏好較晚活動，多於清早活動。

contrast.explanationZh: 稱呼一般指傾向，一次受迫留晚不等於個人長期偏好。

dialogue.promptZh: 你是夜貓子，同伴喜歡早睡，兩人想安排共同錄製時間。哪句較體諒雙方？

options.en: I am a night owl, but let us find a recording time that fits both routines.
options.zh: 我是夜貓子，但找個配合雙方作息的錄製時間吧。

options.en: Use my preferred late hour as the final booking before asking when you are available.
options.zh: 未問你何時有空，就按我愛的深夜時段作最後預訂。

options.en: Offer only late-night slots because that is when you usually work best, without checking the early sleeper’s availability.
options.zh: 只提供你通常表現較好的深夜時段，不查早睡同伴何時有空。

dialogue.explanationZh: 坦誠個人偏好，也查雙方可用時段；不只按自己習慣定最後預訂或把可選時段全限於深夜。

speaking.en: I am a night owl, but I still want our shared plans to work for everyone.
speaking.zh: 我是夜貓子，但仍想共同安排配合每人。
speaking.promptZh: 你想說明個人偏好，也顧及共同需要。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：圖書館想找晚間讀書分享主持。你長期偏好深夜閱讀、整理想法，覺得這個自願崗位合自己習慣，但還要查固定輪值能否配合。用一至兩句英文介紹偏好及考慮。

examples.en: I am a night owl who enjoys reading late, so the evening library session interests me. I still need to check whether I can keep the regular hosting commitment.
examples.zh: 我是喜歡深夜閱讀的夜貓子，所以對圖書館晚間活動感興趣。我仍需查能否履行固定主持安排。

examples.en: Being a night owl makes the late reading session appealing to me, but I want to understand the hosting duties before volunteering.
examples.zh: 作為夜貓子，較晚讀書活動對我有吸引力，但自願報名前，我想先了解主持職責。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用長期閱讀偏好支持夜貓子稱呼，把時段合意與能履行主持職責分開；喜歡深夜不代表已承諾每次輪值。

takeaways.en: My brother is a night owl who enjoys reading late.
takeaways.zh: 我的兄弟是個夜貓子，喜歡深夜閱讀。

takeaways.en: The group includes night owls as well as early risers.
takeaways.zh: 小組既有夜貓子，也有早起者。

sources.sentence: She was burning the midnight oil before the exam.

brief.meaningEn: Work or study late into the night.
brief.meaningZh: 工作或學習至深夜。
brief.grammar: burn/burns/burning/burned/burnt the midnight oil; activity should involve work or study, not merely being awake.
brief.register: Established idiom; no literal oil lamp is required and it does not necessarily mean staying awake all night.
brief.boundaryZh: 不表示一定有效、必定成功或完全沒睡；也不同於只在晚上玩樂。
brief.misconceptionZh: 先查是做工作還是單純夜間活動，不把投入時數當成果證明。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述深夜投入，也清楚分開時段、成果及可持續安排。

options.en: She worked late, without claiming the report no longer needed checking.
options.zh: 她工作到深夜，沒有說報告不用再查。

options.en: She spent the night only watching entertainment unrelated to the report.
options.zh: 她整晚只看與報告無關的娛樂。

options.en: She completed the report’s checks before beginning any revision.
options.zh: 她未開始修改，就已完成報告核對。

options.en: The late working hours prove that every figure is correct.
options.zh: 深夜工時，證明每個數字正確。

listening.explanationZh: revise report 是工作，but 明示仍需核對；熬夜不保證正確。
listening.en: She was burning the midnight oil to revise the report, but the next morning she still needed a fresh check of the figures.
listening.zh: 她熬夜修改報告，但翌晨仍需重新核對數字。

reply.promptEn: What was she doing late last night before the report’s final check?
reply.promptZh: 報告最後核對前，她昨晚深夜在做甚麼？

options.en: She was working on revisions to the report.
options.zh: 她在修改報告。

options.en: She was burning the midnight oil on the report.
options.zh: 她熬夜處理報告。

options.en: She stayed up late to improve the draft.
options.zh: 她留到深夜改善草稿。

options.en: She continued editing late into the night rather than finishing early.
options.zh: 她繼續編輯至深夜，而非早早收工。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均交代深夜修改，金句不是只要清醒就算，也不證明完成核對。

scene.promptZh: 你週末在深夜仍為歷史研究整理引文，而非單純看娛樂。哪句貼切？

options.en: I was burning the midnight oil on the research notes.
options.zh: 我熬夜處理研究筆記。

options.en: I had stopped studying early and spent the rest of the night only watching a comedy.
options.zh: 我早已停止學習，餘下晚上只看喜劇。

options.en: Working late proves the citations need no further checking.
options.zh: 深夜工作，證明引文不用再查。

scene.explanationZh: 深夜研究工作支持熬夜用法，但不代表引文已核對無誤。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不符合 burn the midnight oil？

options.en: Studying a difficult chapter late into the night.
options.zh: 深夜仍研讀難章節。

options.en: Staying awake late solely to watch entertainment, with no work or study involved.
options.zh: 只為看娛樂留到深夜，沒有工作或學習。

options.en: Editing a draft late at night even though some checks remain for tomorrow.
options.zh: 深夜修改草稿，即使明天仍有核對工作。

contrast.explanationZh: 關鍵是工作或學習，不是清醒時間本身；不必代表全完成。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說自己熬夜了，所以報告不需再核對。哪句回應最好？

options.en: Burning the midnight oil shows you worked late, but let us still check the figures before submitting.
options.zh: 熬夜說明你工作至深夜，但提交前仍查數字吧。

options.en: Use the number of late hours as the only evidence that the calculations are accurate.
options.zh: 只以深夜工時，作計算正確的證據。

options.en: Remove the planned check so that the final report reflects how hard you worked rather than what is verified.
options.zh: 取消原定核對，讓最後報告反映努力，而非已確認內容。

dialogue.explanationZh: 工作時段與數據正確不同；回應既承認投入，也保留查證。

speaking.en: I was burning the midnight oil, but I still want another careful check before I call the draft finished.
speaking.zh: 我熬夜工作，但說草稿完成前，仍想再細查。
speaking.promptZh: 你想交代深夜投入，卻不把時數當結果。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫一段人物訪問：受訪者昨晚為修復家族相簿工作至深夜，之後有睡；你要準確說熬夜工作，不誇大成整晚沒睡或修復必定成功。用一至兩句英文描述。

examples.en: She was burning the midnight oil to restore the family album, but she did get some sleep afterwards.
examples.zh: 她熬夜修復家族相簿，但之後確實睡了一會。

examples.en: He burned the midnight oil on the damaged photographs, although he stopped for the night before every repair was complete.
examples.zh: 他熬夜處理受損照片，但所有修復完成前，他便停下來休息。

writing.selfCheckZh: 準確交代修復工作在深夜進行，也容許之後睡覺及修復未完；不要把片語擴成通宵或品質保證。

takeaways.en: She burned the midnight oil while preparing the exhibition notes.
takeaways.zh: 準備展覽筆記時，她熬夜工作。

takeaways.en: We were burning the midnight oil, but the draft still needed checking.
takeaways.zh: 我們熬夜工作，但草稿仍需核對。

brief.meaningEn: Very absorbed in watching a screen or phone, often with little attention for other things.
brief.meaningZh: 非常專注看螢幕或手機，往往很少注意其他事情。
brief.grammar: be glued to a screen / their screens / a different screen; the idiom marks intense absorbed attention, not physical glue. Different can distinguish each person's device.
brief.register: Conventional glue metaphor for absorbed attention; context determines whether the attention is helpful or disruptive.
brief.boundaryZh: 不表示真的不能移動，也不一概指懶惰或成癮；學習或有意義事件也可令人投入。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要看注意集中及情境影響，不只按裝置存在或觀看時間判斷。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述螢幕投入程度，也辨別是否忽略共同活動。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: 螢幕與手機都可作投入觀看的對象；這裏的黏着是注意力的比喻，不是實際無法移動。

options.en: Their attention was absorbed by the match rather than the conversation.
options.zh: 他們注意被比賽吸住，而非留意對話。

options.en: They checked the score briefly and then took part in most of the conversation.
options.zh: 他們只短暫查分，之後參與大部分對話。

options.en: The devices were present but nobody looked at them during dinner.
options.zh: 裝置在場，但晚餐時沒人看。

options.en: They were watching only to answer a quick practical question before returning to the conversation.
options.zh: 他們只為回答一個簡短實際問題而看，之後便回到對話。

listening.explanationZh: so closely 及 missed most of the conversation 交代持續投入及漏聽對話；不是只短暫查分或為一個實際問題觀看。
listening.en: During dinner, they were glued to their screens, following the match so closely that they missed most of the conversation around the table.
listening.zh: 晚餐時，他們注意力牢牢黏在螢幕上，太投入看比賽，錯過桌邊大部分對話。

reply.promptEn: Why did they miss most of the dinner conversation while the match was on?
reply.promptZh: 播放比賽時，他們為甚麼錯過大部分晚餐對話？

options.en: They were concentrating on the match rather than listening around the table.
options.zh: 他們專注比賽，而非聽桌邊對話。

options.en: They were glued to their screens.
options.zh: 他們注意力牢牢黏在螢幕上。

options.en: The action on the display held nearly all their attention.
options.zh: 畫面上的賽況幾乎吸住全部注意。

options.en: They followed each moment of the game and hardly noticed the conversation.
options.zh: 他們追看賽事每一刻，幾乎沒注意對話。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均解釋漏聽對話的投入，不從一次情況診斷成癮。

scene.promptZh: 觀眾看直播中等待已久的登月模擬成果，目不轉睛、專注每個細節。題目沒有說影響其他責任。哪句可用？

options.en: The viewers were glued to their screens during the demonstration.
options.zh: 示範期間，觀眾注意力牢牢黏在螢幕上。

options.en: The phrase cannot apply because they were watching something meaningful.
options.zh: 因為他們看有意義的內容，片語便不能用。

options.en: They ignored the demonstration and only discussed an unrelated topic.
options.zh: 他們沒理示範，只談無關題目。

scene.explanationZh: 有意義內容也可吸住注意，不必負面；重點是投入程度。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜只憑 glued to their screens 得出？

options.en: The people are deeply absorbed in viewing.
options.zh: 那些人非常投入觀看。

options.en: The people must be clinically addicted or morally lazy.
options.zh: 那些人必定臨床成癮或品格懶惰。

options.en: Context is needed to judge the effect on other activities.
options.zh: 要看情境，才判斷對其他活動的影響。

contrast.explanationZh: 形容注意投入，不自行確立疾病或品格判斷。

dialogue.promptZh: 家人看比賽太投入而漏聽共同晚餐聊天，你想提一個具體安排而不辱罵。哪句最好？

options.en: We have been glued to our screens; shall we pause the viewing for part of dinner and catch up with one another?
options.zh: 我們一直只顧看螢幕；可否晚餐一段時間暫停觀看，和彼此聊近況？

options.en: Leave the match playing throughout dinner and assume people can follow every play and the whole conversation equally well.
options.zh: 晚餐全程繼續播比賽，假定大家可同樣跟上每球及整段對話。

options.en: Send the dinner conversation to a group chat so that everyone has another screen to follow during the match.
options.zh: 把晚餐對話轉到群組聊天，讓每人看比賽時再追另一個螢幕。

dialogue.explanationZh: 題目已知大家漏聽，暫停部分觀看可留聊天空間；假定能同樣專注或加另一個螢幕，未回應共同對話需要。

speaking.en: We were glued to our screens, so I would like us to make some room for conversation too.
speaking.zh: 我們只顧看螢幕，所以我也想留一些聊天空間。
speaking.promptZh: 你想描述注意分配並提出共同安排。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：插畫員把自己的數碼海報放大，專注檢查邊線並記下要改的地方。她太投入看自己的草稿，存好筆記後才發覺旁邊的茶已冷；你只描述當時注意，不保證作品完美。用一至兩句英文描寫。

examples.en: She was glued to the screen while checking the edges of her own poster. The tea cooled beside her before she noticed it.
examples.zh: 檢查自己海報邊線時，她注意力牢牢黏在螢幕上。旁邊茶冷了，她才發覺。

examples.en: I was glued to my screen, enlarging the draft to inspect the lines. I only noticed the cold tea after saving my notes.
examples.zh: 我把草稿放大查線條，注意力牢牢黏在螢幕上。存好筆記後，我才留意冷茶。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用放大自作草稿、查邊線及沒留意茶冷，支持當時注意投入；不從專注推論作品已無錯或替當事人作診斷。

takeaways.en: They were glued to their screens as the final results appeared.
takeaways.zh: 最後結果出現時，他們注意力牢牢黏在螢幕上。

takeaways.en: During the meeting, each guest was glued to a different screen instead of joining the discussion.
takeaways.zh: 會議期間，各賓客只顧看著不同的螢幕，沒有參與討論。

brief.meaningEn: Something happens surprisingly soon or before a person notices the change.
brief.meaningZh: 事情比預期快，或當事人尚未察覺改變便已發生。
brief.grammar: before you know it; before they knew it in past narration; match know/knows/knew to subject and tense.
brief.register: Conventional conversational expression for unnoticed or surprisingly quick change; not a literal deadline for learning a fact.
brief.boundaryZh: 不提供精確時長，也不一定是壞事；不等於故意隱瞞。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需看變化及察覺時機，不能只因有 before 就當普通先後條件。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述迅速或不經意變化，清楚保留具體情境。

options.en: The order grew beyond their needs before they noticed the total.
options.zh: 他們察覺總量前，訂單已超出所需。

options.en: They deliberately agreed the final total first and then ordered exactly that amount.
options.zh: 他們先刻意議定總量，再按該數量下單。

options.en: They noticed the rising total immediately and reduced the order before it exceeded their needs.
options.zh: 他們即時察覺總量上升，在超出所需前已減少訂單。

options.en: The group knew the order was excessive from the start and made no further changes.
options.zh: 全組一開始就知訂單過量，之後沒有加改。

listening.explanationZh: 不斷再加與之後察覺過量，支持不經意累積；不是先定好總量，或過量前已即時察覺並減單。
listening.en: We kept adding one more dish to the shared order, and before we knew it we had chosen far more food than the group needed.
listening.zh: 我們不斷在合點訂單加一道菜，還未察覺，就已選了遠多於全組所需的食物。

reply.promptEn: How did the shared order become larger than the group needed?
reply.promptZh: 合點訂單怎樣變得超出全組所需？

options.en: We kept adding dishes without checking the running total.
options.zh: 我們不斷加菜，沒有查看累計數量。

options.en: Before we knew it, we had chosen too much food.
options.zh: 還未察覺，我們就已選太多食物。

options.en: The small additions accumulated faster than we noticed.
options.zh: 小幅增加累積得比我們察覺快。

options.en: We only realised the overall amount after several extra choices.
options.zh: 加選幾次後，我們才發覺總量。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明不經意累積；金句描述察覺時機，不說故意隱瞞。

scene.promptZh: 你翻相簿，逐頁看故事，抬頭才發現已到約定出門時間，原以為只看了一會。哪句貼切？

options.en: Before I knew it, it was time to leave.
options.zh: 還未察覺，便到出門時間。

options.en: I checked the clock continuously and expected the departure time at every moment.
options.zh: 我一直看鐘，每刻都預期出門時間。

options.en: I had intended to leave much later and was still waiting for the agreed time.
options.zh: 我原定更晚出門，仍在等議定時間。

scene.explanationZh: 時間未及察覺就到，不是一直預期看鐘，也不是仍等更晚出門。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜只憑 before you know it 得出？

options.en: A change may feel surprisingly quick.
options.zh: 改變可能感覺出乎意料地快。

options.en: The phrase always states an exact number of seconds.
options.zh: 片語總是說明精確秒數。

options.en: The result can be welcome or unwelcome depending on context.
options.zh: 結果可好可壞，要看情境。

contrast.explanationZh: 這是對迅速及察覺的概括，不是精密計時或固定負面結果。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴聽到 before we knew it，就想寫成有人故意隱瞞訂單總量；原情境只說大家沒留意累計。哪句較準確？

options.en: “Before we knew it” describes how quickly the total escaped our notice; it does not by itself show deliberate concealment.
options.zh: 「還未察覺便已經」描述總量很快超出我們注意，本身不顯示故意隱瞞。

options.en: Report a hidden order as established fact without checking who saw the running total.
options.zh: 未查誰看過累計數量，就把秘密訂單當已確立事實。

options.en: Describe the food as one sudden order rather than additions that accumulated without being noticed.
options.zh: 把食物寫成一次突然下單，而非未被留意的逐次累積。

dialogue.explanationZh: 句子交代逐次加選而未察覺總量，既不證明故意隱瞞，也不表示所有食物一次突然下單。

speaking.en: Before we knew it, the small additions had grown into more work than we expected.
speaking.zh: 還未察覺，小幅增加已變成超出預期的工作量。
speaking.promptZh: 你想描述不經意累積，不暗示精確時長。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你看自己的畫畫練習冊，逐週少量練習，今天回看才驚覺已能完成以前覺得很難的草圖。用一至兩句英文描述這次正面的不經意改變。

examples.en: Before I knew it, I could draw scenes that had once felt too difficult. Looking back through the sketchbook made the gradual progress visible.
examples.zh: 還未察覺，我已能畫以前覺得太難的場景。回看練習冊，讓逐漸進步變得可見。

examples.en: I practised a little each week, and before I knew it the difficult sketches had become more manageable.
examples.zh: 我每週練習一點，還未察覺，難畫草圖就已較能應付。

writing.selfCheckZh: 描述回看才驚覺的進步，保留每週練習，不說毫無投入就學會；表達也可用於正面結果。

takeaways.en: Before we knew it, the afternoon had passed.
takeaways.zh: 還未察覺，下午就過去了。

takeaways.en: Keep making small improvements, and before you know it the task may feel more manageable.
takeaways.zh: 持續小幅改善，還未察覺，工作可能就較能應付。

sources.sentence: It is midnight already; time has flown.

brief.meaningEn: Time seems to have passed quickly.
brief.meaningZh: 時間彷彿過得很快。
brief.grammar: time flies in general present; time flew in a past event; time has flown when looking back to now; fly–flew–flown.
brief.register: Conventional passage-of-time idiom; the source perfect form belongs to the same time-flies expression.
brief.boundaryZh: 說的是感受，不表示鐘壞或時間實際改速；快過也不保證當時開心。
brief.misconceptionZh: 須配合時態及回望時點，不把 flown 寫成一般過去式。
brief.outcomeZh: 能自然回顧時間迅速過去，也留意實際安排。

options.en: The years seem to have passed quickly when viewed from the present.
options.zh: 從現在回望，幾年彷彿過得很快。

options.en: Only a few days have actually passed since the first lesson.
options.zh: 自第一課起，實際只過幾天。

options.en: The first lesson feels extremely distant because every year seemed slow.
options.zh: 每年都感覺緩慢，所以第一課顯得很遙遠。

options.en: The photograph shows that the group met for the first time only this week.
options.zh: 照片顯示全組本星期才首次見面。

listening.explanationZh: 幾年已過卻感覺仍近，表達主觀迅速；不是實際只幾天，或本週才見面。
listening.en: Looking at the old class photograph now, I realise that time has flown: several years have passed, although the first lesson still feels recent.
listening.zh: 現在看舊班照，我發覺時間飛快過去：已過幾年，但第一課仍像最近的事。

reply.promptEn: How does it feel to look at the photograph several years after the first lesson?
reply.promptZh: 第一課幾年後看照片，感覺怎樣？

options.en: It is surprising how quickly the years seem to have passed.
options.zh: 幾年彷彿過得很快，令人驚訝。

options.en: Time has flown since we first met in that classroom.
options.zh: 自我們首次在課室相遇，時間飛快過去。

options.en: The photograph makes the first lesson feel much more recent than it was.
options.zh: 照片令第一課感覺比實際近得多。

options.en: I know several years have passed, but they do not feel that long.
options.zh: 我知已過幾年，但感覺沒那麼久。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都表達回望的迅速感，不改變實際年數。

scene.promptZh: 整理檔案時，你發現項目已做三年，自己卻仍覺開場會議像不久前；想用現在完成式回顧。哪句合適？

options.en: Time has flown since our first planning meeting.
options.zh: 自首次策劃會議起，時間飛快過去。

options.en: The last three years have felt unusually slow.
options.zh: 過去三年感覺異常緩慢。

options.en: Only a short time has actually passed since our first planning meeting.
options.zh: 首次策劃會議以來，實際只過很短時間。

scene.explanationZh: 已過三年卻感覺很近，支持 time has flown 的迅速感；不是時間感緩慢，也不是實際只過短時間。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 time has flown 得出？

options.en: A period seems to have gone quickly.
options.zh: 一段時間彷彿很快過去。

options.en: The person must have enjoyed every moment of that period.
options.zh: 當事人必定享受那段時間每一刻。

options.en: A present-perfect form can connect the earlier period to the present view.
options.zh: 現在完成式可把先前時段連到現在回望。

contrast.explanationZh: 迅速感不保證每刻快樂，也可回望繁忙或複雜時段。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說 time has flown，便以為不需查實際周年日期。你正安排紀念活動。哪句最好？

options.en: Time has flown, but let us check the actual date before putting the anniversary on the invitation.
options.zh: 時間過得快，但把周年寫上邀請前，仍查實際日期吧。

options.en: Use how recent the first meeting feels as the only basis for the anniversary date.
options.zh: 只按首次會議感覺有多近，決定周年日期。

options.en: Record the date from memory without comparing it with the original meeting notice.
options.zh: 不對照最初會議通知，只憑記憶寫日期。

dialogue.explanationZh: 感受快慢不能代替實際日期，紀念活動仍需核實。

speaking.en: Time has flown since we began, but I still want to check the dates before writing the summary.
speaking.zh: 開始至今時間過得快，但寫摘要前，我仍想核對日期。
speaking.promptZh: 你想表達感受，也區分實際時間資料。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你編輯一段旅行日記，旅程當時每天都很充實；回家後想寫昨天最後一天下午彷彿一轉眼過去，但仍趕上回程車。用一至兩句英文描述，配合過去時點。

examples.en: Time flew on the final afternoon of the trip, but we still checked the departure time and caught the train home.
examples.zh: 旅程最後下午，時間彷彿飛快過去，但我們仍查出發時間，趕上回家的火車。

examples.en: By the time we packed, time had flown and the final afternoon was nearly over. We checked the return journey rather than relying on how much time seemed left.
examples.zh: 收拾行李時，時間已彷彿飛快過去，最後下午快完。我們核對回程，而非只憑感覺還剩多少時間。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用 flew 或 had flown 配合昨天回顧，描述時光迅速，也保留核對回程的實際安排。

takeaways.en: Time has flown since we started working together.
takeaways.zh: 開始合作以來，時間彷彿飛快過去。

takeaways.en: Time flew while we explored the exhibition.
takeaways.zh: 參觀展覽時，時間彷彿飛快過去。

sources.sentence: At a family event, time is not just money.

brief.meaningEn: Time has value beyond financial cost, such as care, respect, trust or shared experience.
brief.meaningZh: 時間不只具金錢成本，也關乎關心、尊重、信任或共同經驗。
brief.grammar: time is not just money; name the additional value in context; this deliberately extends the familiar time-is-money saying.
brief.register: Contextual figurative variation on a conventional saying, not a demand to ignore economic costs.
brief.boundaryZh: not just 保留金錢價值，再加其他層面；不是說金錢完全不重要，也不把所有遲到當故意。
brief.misconceptionZh: 說清具體非金錢影響，不只重複抽象珍惜時間。
brief.outcomeZh: 能解釋時間安排如何影響別人，並回應實際需要。

listening.promptZh: 這個變化說法強調甚麼？

options.en: Time can affect trust and respect as well as financial cost.
options.zh: 時間除金錢成本，也可影響信任及尊重。

options.en: Money never matters in any arrangement.
options.zh: 任何安排中，金錢都不重要。

options.en: Every delay proves that someone intended to insult the group.
options.zh: 每次延誤都證明有人故意侮辱全組。

options.en: Only paid work gives a person’s waiting time any value.
options.zh: 只有受薪工作，才令一個人等待時間有價值。

listening.explanationZh: not just 加上信任及尊重，沒有否定金錢或證明延誤動機。
listening.en: When friends wait without an update, time is not just money: the delay can also weaken trust that their plans and effort will be respected.
listening.zh: 朋友沒有收到更新便一直等時，時間價值不止金錢：延誤也可能削弱他們對自身安排及付出會獲尊重的信任。

reply.promptEn: Why should someone update friends when an agreed meeting time changes?
reply.promptZh: 議定見面時間改變時，為甚麼應通知朋友？

options.en: The friends have organised their own time and deserve clear information.
options.zh: 朋友已安排自己的時間，值得獲清楚資訊。

options.en: Time is not just money; it also involves trust and respect for their plans.
options.zh: 時間價值不止金錢，也涉及信任及尊重他們的安排。

options.en: An update lets them decide how to use the waiting time.
options.zh: 更新讓他們決定怎樣運用等待時間。

options.en: Even an unpaid social meeting can matter to someone who has made an effort to attend.
options.zh: 即使無薪社交聚會，對付出努力前來的人也可重要。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都回答通知的重要，金句保留金錢以外的時間價值。

scene.promptZh: 家人特地留晚飯時間陪你，你延誤時主動通知，因為他們的相聚安排也重要，不只收入損失。哪句合適？

options.en: Time is not just money; their shared plans deserve consideration too.
options.zh: 時間價值不止金錢；他們的共同安排也值得顧及。

options.en: If nobody loses wages, the waiting has no value worth discussing.
options.zh: 若沒人少了工資，等待就沒有值得討論的價值。

options.en: Giving an update means the original delay can have no effect on anyone’s plans.
options.zh: 通知更新，表示原來延誤不會影響任何人的安排。

scene.explanationZh: 關心相聚安排支持非金錢價值，更新可幫人調整卻不抹去所有影響。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項誤讀了 time is not just money？

options.en: Financial cost may matter, alongside other forms of value.
options.zh: 金錢成本可能重要，也有其他價值。

options.en: The sentence necessarily means money is entirely irrelevant.
options.zh: 句子必定表示金錢完全無關。

options.en: Context should explain the additional value, such as respect for shared plans.
options.zh: 情境應說清額外價值，例如尊重共同安排。

contrast.explanationZh: not just 是不止，不是完全否定原有層面。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說活動免費，所以臨時取消也不用告訴已準備的人。哪句回應最好？

options.en: Time is not just money; tell them promptly so they can change the plans they made for us.
options.zh: 時間價值不止金錢；盡快告訴他們，好讓他們改為我們而作的安排。

options.en: Measure the cancellation only by ticket refunds and ignore the preparation people have already done.
options.zh: 只按退票衡量取消，不理大家已做的準備。

options.en: Wait until people arrive before explaining, because the free ticket means no time was invested.
options.zh: 因免費票表示沒投入時間，等人到場才解釋。

dialogue.explanationZh: 免費不表示沒有時間投入；及時通知回應已作準備與後續選擇。

speaking.en: Time is not just money, so I want to respect the plans people have made to be here.
speaking.zh: 時間價值不止金錢，所以我想尊重大家為到場所作的安排。
speaking.promptZh: 你想把非金錢價值連到具體安排。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你策劃免費口述歷史工作坊，長者特地帶家庭記錄前來。你想留足分享時間，不只把每分鐘當費用，也顧及他們分享回憶的機會。用一至兩句英文說明。

examples.en: Time is not just money in this workshop; it is also a chance for the visitors to share family memories. We should leave enough room for their stories.
examples.zh: 這個工作坊的時間價值不止金錢，也讓訪客有機會分享家庭回憶。我們應為故事留足時間。

examples.en: When planning the session, I remember that time is not just money: a rushed schedule could lose the personal stories people came to share.
examples.zh: 策劃這一節時，我記住時間價值不止金錢：匆忙時間表可能錯失大家特地前來分享的個人故事。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出分享回憶這項具體價值及留足時間的安排；不把免費當時間沒價值，也不說費用完全不重要。

takeaways.en: Time is not just money; it can also express care for the people waiting.
takeaways.zh: 時間價值不止金錢，也可表達對等待者的關心。

takeaways.en: Time was not just money in that project, because people were sharing experiences that mattered to them.
takeaways.zh: 該項目中，時間價值不止金錢，因為大家分享自己珍視的經驗。
